note.question: What role does screening play in multistage contests?
note.overview: Firms seek to use the contest format to source solutions from a broader network of outside solvers. This paper studies the application of the contest approach in multistage settings and show how and when screening of contestants between stages can produce improved contest outcomes. We present an application-driven game-theoretic model to capture imperfections in screening using the true-positive rate (sensitivity) and the true-negative rate (specificity).
